about: A self-hosted file manager for a home server, used from the web browser.

prs.title: Moving a folder between drives keeps links and file permissions
prs.broken: Moving a folder to another drive copies it, then deletes the original. The copy dropped shortcut links and made scripts lose their run permission, while the job said it finished.
prs.changed: I made folder copies recreate the links and keep each file's permissions.
prs.matters: Moving folders between disks no longer quietly loses files or breaks scripts.
